mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(SUM(learning_time) / 3600.0) AS total_learning_hours FROM cloud_computing_student_learning_record cslr LEFT JOIN sys_account u ON u.id = cslr.user_id WHERE u.username = #{UserName} AND learning_time > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DATE(csld.create_time) AS d FROM cloud_computing_student_learning_record csld LEFT JOIN sys_account u ON u.id = csld.user_id WHERE u.username = #{UserName} UNION SELECT DATE(csld.last_learn_time) AS d FROM cloud_computing_student_learning_record csld LEFT JOIN sys_account u ON u.id = csld.user_id WHERE u.username = #{UserName}) AS unique_days
